subject: Hospitality
title: Sponsorship Revenue Models
description: A fast breakdown of Sponsorship Revenue Models for builders.

hook.text: Sponsorship can cover 30–60% of an event's costs. For many conferences, sponsors—not ticket sales—are the primary revenue source.

buildup.text: Sponsorship tiers (platinum, gold, silver) offer escalating visibility: logo placement, booth space, speaking slots.

discovery.text: The most valuable sponsorship isn't a banner—it's branded content: a sponsor-led workshop beats a logo on a wall.

twist.text: Over-sponsorship alienates attendees. When every session has a sponsor intro and every surface has a logo.

climax.text: The best sponsorship integrates naturally: charging stations branded by a tech company, wellness areas by a health brand.

punchline.text: 30–60% of event revenue from sponsors. The key: integrate the brand, don't wallpaper it.

quiz.question: What percentage of event costs can sponsorship cover?
